remaining.title: aria-pressed on the preset chips (asked for in Sofía's friction list)
remaining.why: Implemented differently on purpose. aria-pressed="true" on a control that cannot un-press itself lies to a screen reader — tapping an already-added preset does not remove those items, so the state would be permanent and unresponsive. The chips instead carry a visible .on state with a tick and a stateful accessible name ("🏖️ Beach — all 8 already on your list" vs "🏖️ Beach — add 8 of 8 items"), and tapping now toasts which preset and what was skipped ("🧳 Essentials: 6 items added (3 already there)"). aria-pressed IS used on the Hide packed control, which is a genuine toggle.

remaining.title: An export/import file ("Download list", "Open a saved list")
remaining.why: Dee's and the research's second-half failure — losing everything to a browser clear or a phone swap — is real, but it is a mostWantedNext feature, not one of the 14 fixes in the work order, and it needs a file format decision that should be made once for the portfolio rather than invented in this app. The immediate exposure is reduced: there are now saved trips rather than one overwritable list, the storage layer survives corruption instead of bricking, and a save that fails says so out loud and points at Copy link.
